The department advances warfighter lethality, operational effectiveness, and acquisition acceleration for the Department of War. N221’s mission-focused portfolio spans several business lines—Cyber, Electronic Warfare, Installation Resilience and Operational Energy, Industrial Base and Investments, Software and Digital Modernization, Threat and Risk Reduction, and Force Design Analysis and FMS reform. The department leverages cutting-edge technologies, data-driven analysis, and innovative acquisition practices to ensure U.S. military superiority in contested environments. Develop and maintain project strategic plans in collaboration with DOT&E Government leadership. Define and manage staffing requirements to ensure that the right staffing skill mix and resources Work closely with division and department Chief Engineers to ensure quality of deliverables and identify opportunities for MITRE research to be applied to sponsor-relevant efforts.
